definitions.explanation: Light-colored, mildly sweet miso made with a high ratio of rice koji and a short fermentation period. Associated with Kyoto and Western Japan; the standard miso for ozōni in those regions.

examples.japanese: {白味噌|しろみそ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧。
examples.english: Miso soup made with white miso is sweet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雑煮|ぞうに}→雑煮：14581_zouni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白味噌|しろみそ}{仕立|じた}て⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ。
examples.english: Kyoto-style ozoni is basically made with white miso.

examples.japanese: {白味噌|しろみそ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{熟成期間|じゅくせいきかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{利|き}かない→利く：11845_kiku⟧。
examples.english: Because white miso has a short fermentation period, it doesn't keep very well.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧ (white) + ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧ (miso). Contrasts with ⟦{赤味噌|あかみそ}→赤味噌：28918_akamiso⟧ (red miso) and ⟦{合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}→合わせ味噌：28934_awasemiso⟧ (mixed miso).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白味噌|しろみそ}{仕立|じた}て: prepared with white miso (esp. of soup)
- {白味噌|しろみそ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧: miso soup with white miso
- {京|きょう}{白味噌|しろみそ}: Kyoto white miso
- {白味噌|しろみそ}⟦{雑煮|ぞうに}→雑煮：14581_zouni⟧: white-miso ozoni (New Year's soup)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{赤味噌|あかみそ}→赤味噌：28918_akamiso⟧: red miso — darker, saltier, longer fermentation
- ⟦{合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}→合わせ味噌：28934_awasemiso⟧: blended miso — mix of white and red
- ⟦{麦|むぎ}→麦：05427_mugi⟧⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧: barley miso — common in Kyushu
